name: tasks.create
description: Create an encrypted task in an owned chain. A live chain publishes and may dispatch immediately; a draft chain retains drafts. To offload, select a durable assignee_agent_id and explicit bridge_id after configuring its fleet placement. Reuse request_id with identical arguments on retries. Returns a stable public operation snapshot: identifiers, resulting state/revision, applied fields, changed/checkpoint flags and safe action/reason codes. Detailed private blockers are available through tasks.get.

name: tasks.update
description: Patch an owned task through native rules. Supply expected_revision from tasks.get and a stable request_id. Leased tasks retain native edit restrictions; omitted fields stay unchanged. Task-read permission is needed to obtain revisions. Returns a stable public operation snapshot: identifiers, resulting state/revision, applied fields, changed/checkpoint flags and safe action/reason codes. Detailed private blockers are available through tasks.get.

name: tasks.control
description: Use a native task action with expected_revision from tasks.get and stable request_id. Approval/review and external leases are unavailable. Hold, cancel and answer require a reason. Workflow tasks retain engine restrictions. Returns a stable public operation snapshot: identifiers, resulting state/revision, applied fields, changed/checkpoint flags and safe action/reason codes. Detailed private blockers are available through tasks.get.

name: chains.configure
description: Configure an owned chain using configuration_revision from chains.get as expected_revision. Action fleet pins an owned durable agent to an explicit owned online bridge and supported provider/model; action publish publishes the chain through native validation. Reuse request_id for retries. Can dispatch waiting work. Returns a stable public operation snapshot: identifiers, resulting state/revision, applied fields, changed/checkpoint flags and safe action/reason codes. Detailed private blockers are available through tasks.get.

name: tasks.list
description: List bounded task summaries in one owned chain. Optional native state and durable assignee filters apply before stable owner/chain/filter-bound keyset paging.

name: tasks.get
description: Read an exact chain/task pair: bounded brief, dependencies, latest attempt summary/reviewer references, native allowed actions, blocking/hold overlay and revision. Comments are opt-in with owner/task-bound keyset paging, a 1MiB page budget and explicit body_error for individual oversized comments. Metadata stays readable independently of comment history.

name: tasks.comment
description: Add an encrypted comment to an exact owned chain/task. Stable request_id deduplicates identical retries. Returns comment ID, timestamp and persisted delegated-user/client attribution; cannot impersonate an agent/reviewer. Sends no messages.

name: chains.list
description: List your Heimdall task chains in readable form.

name: chains.get
description: Read an owned chain, task/review status and comments.

name: chains.create
description: Create an encrypted draft chain as the connected user. Does not assign or launch an agent. Do not automatically retry an ambiguous result.

name: events.wait
description: Wait for an owner change hint, then return a fresh owned-chain snapshot. Client-driven polling only: keep calling while actively monitoring with a stopping condition and budget. No replay or background wake guarantee.

name: agents.list
description: List stable owner-bound pages of durable agent definitions. Optional active/archived filter precedes paging. Summaries omit instructions; records carry revisions. Does not launch sessions.

name: agents.get
description: Read an owned durable agent_id, encrypted instructions, template reference, permission mode, support configuration and revision. Does not read credentials or launch sessions.

name: agents.create
description: Create an encrypted durable agent definition, not a running session. Native template/support ownership rules apply. permission_mode defaults to the native yolo default; ask is explicit. Reuse request_id with identical arguments on retries. Returns public operation metadata and revision.

name: agents.update
description: Patch an owned durable definition using expected_revision from agents.get and stable request_id. Instructions/name/slug are encrypted; supports replaces the support configuration. Does not launch, move or stop existing sessions. An existing ask permission mode cannot be weakened to yolo; yolo may be tightened to ask.

name: agents.archive
description: Archive an owned durable definition while retaining historic references. Native archive does not stop existing sessions. Supply current revision and stable request_id; this is not permanent deletion.

name: bridges.list
description: List owner-bound pages of owned execution bridges with status, platform and enrollment/plan eligibility. No credentials, hostname, commands or diagnostic dumps.

name: providers.list
description: Discover provider profiles/effective models on an exact owned bridge_id; optional owned agent_id checks support. Profiles use limit/cursor; models use model_limit and each record models_next_cursor. Continue models with that provider_profile plus model_cursor; do not combine profile/model cursors. Eligibility is configuration availability, not a capacity reservation, and writes recheck it. No credentials, arguments or environment; no silent target fallback.

name: instances.list
description: List owned managed agent_instance_id records with explicit durable agent_id, bridge/provider/profile/model, status and task references. Filters precede stable owner-bound paging. No tokens, transcripts, environment or raw diagnostics.

name: instances.get
description: Read one owned managed agent_instance_id public status/configuration snapshot. Runtime identity is distinct from durable agent_id. No credentials, environment, command lines or diagnostics.

name: instances.create
description: Control an owned managed instance. Reuse identical request_id and arguments after ambiguous results. Active task leases must be explicitly held and checkpointed first. Permission changes are forbidden; accepted does not mean runtime ready. Poll instances.operations.

expected_revision.description: Revision from agents.get for create, instances.get for other actions.

name: instances.start
description: Control an owned managed instance. Reuse identical request_id and arguments after ambiguous results. Active task leases must be explicitly held and checkpointed first. Permission changes are forbidden; accepted does not mean runtime ready. Poll instances.operations.

expected_revision.description: Revision from agents.get for create, instances.get for other actions.

expected_revision.description: Revision from agents.get for create, instances.get for other actions.

name: instances.reconfigure
description: Control an owned managed instance. Reuse identical request_id and arguments after ambiguous results. Active task leases must be explicitly held and checkpointed first. Permission changes are forbidden; accepted does not mean runtime ready. Poll instances.operations.

expected_revision.description: Revision from agents.get for create, instances.get for other actions.

retry_request_id.description: Original reconfigure request_id for explicit recovery retry with a new request_id. Destination must match.

name: instances.operations
description: Poll the durable operation selected by operation_tool and request_id; reads never resend commands.

name: memories.list
description: Read owned records with stable owner/filter-bound paging. Lists omit memory body/evidence; issues.get comments are opt-in with separate comment_limit/comment_cursor.
